profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer (Front End) at Walmart Global Tech
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Currently working as a front-end tech lead building internal tools for Walmart. Passionate about testing, React, component libraries and build pipelines. Past experience with UX and graphic design.

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description: Manage a team of Developers who create OnDeck's public facing web and email properties.

positions.title: Senior Design Engineer
positions.description: Managed a team of Design Engineers.

positions.title: Front End Developer (contract)
positions.description:
• Responsible for coding the mobile web and responsive aspects of JackThreads.com
• Wrote and revised custom modules using Coffeescript, Sass, Backbone and Mustache
• Testing and coding on a wide range of mobile devices
• Recoded all JackThreads.com email templates with a new design and made many of them responsive on supported email clients
• Added custom triggers for Google Analytics event tracking
• Revised flow for mobile Facebook login and recoded Facebook integration for wanting items

positions.title: Front End Developer and Designer (contract)
positions.description:
• Built the front end for a wide range of sites using HTML5, CSS3 and custom JavaScript
• Rapid prototyping using tools like Bootstrap, jQuery Mobile, Yeoman, Sass and Compass
• Built responsive designs using flexible grids and media queries
• Designed websites, web apps, information graphics and presentations
• Improved UX with progressive enhancement and detecting browser features
• Illustrated characters and scenes for animations and graphics
• Created wireframes for the user interface of sites and apps
• Collaborated with and directed the design and development work of other contractors

positions.title: Design Director and Front End Developer
positions.description:
•   Supervised the design and front-end production work for all projects. Assigned work to designers and front-end developers and revised, as needed. 
•  Designed websites for clients including Audubon, The Anti-Defamation League, EIF/Revlon, United Hospital Fund, World Wildlife Fund and many others.
•  Conducted design and planning meetings with clients. 
•  Created user interface wireframes showing the information architecture of a site. 
•  Produced site templates using valid HTML, CSS and Javascript. 
•  Designed and created HTML newsletters and tested across multiple email clients 
•  Created interactive Flash intros, tools, games and websites. 
•  Wrote website analyses from the perspective of design, usability and accessibility. 
•  Designed, illustrated and programmed educational Flash games for clients such as Audubon, Liberty Science Center and World Wildlife Fund.

positions.title: Founding member, designer, podcast producer
positions.description:
•  Designed, built and maintained the websites and products for the Politipunk brand.
•  Produced a weekly music and news podcast with over 90,000 total downloads.
•  Designed t-shirts that were worn by celebrities including Natalie Portman, Paris Hilton and Michael Stipe.

positions.title: Design Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for page layouts and typographical adjustments to Yale University Press publications
